cases.sentence: Когда Иисус сидел на ___, ученики подошли к Нему наедине и спросили:
cases.explain: «Масличной горе» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

cases.translation: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
